text:
rafa (PM): quick thought  propose we run a hypothesis-first DP wave (8 partners) where each partner signs a 1-sentence hypothesis we can test end-to-end. goal: avoid feature-snowballing and get measurable pass/fail per hypothesis. looking for quick alignment on required artifacts + acceptance gates.

jo (Research): love this. require for each partner: 12 test prompts, 3 user scenarios, and a primary metric (eg. task completion rate or mean latency). also request a short 2-paragraph context note so we can interpret results.

moh (EngOps): telemetry baseline is must: capture pre-pilot perf for their requests if possible, otherwise capture first-week baseline. events to instrument: `dp.hypothesis.kickoff`, `dp.hypothesis.first_success`, `dp.hypothesis.regression_detected`. recommend automated daily summary emailed to partner and PM.

zara (Sales): Sales asks we include an "intent to convert" checkbox and expected ARR estimate on intake. conversion trigger idea: partner meets hypothesis AND operational gates for 2 weeks -> eligible for conversion offer. we need a simple conversion playbook.

alaa (Legal): add pilot addendum toggles: data-sharing consent, de-id permission for eval artifacts, and a short clause around IP of any co-created prompts. if regulated data is in scope mark as "restricted" and require VPC/on-prem.

rafa (PM): proposed acceptance gates (all required to mark hypothesis validated):
```
- Reproducible artifact submission (prompts + scenarios)
- Primary metric improvement >= threshold or steady state with no regressions for 2 weeks
- Ops checklist: contact roster, runbook, and monitoring hooks
- Legal: signed pilot addendum
```
if all pass -> label hypothesis VALIDATED and trigger conversion outreach.

jo (Research): also add qualitative sign-off: 1 mid-pilot 30m interview + final 45m retrospective. that helps contextualize noisy metrics.

moh (EngOps): for scope negotiation: any infra work estimated > 3 engineer-days needs explicit SOW-lite approval and will count against PS hours. we'll provide a compatibility test script partners must run pre-onboard.

zara (Sales): OK to offer a 60-day conversion window at a preferred rate if partner opts in within 30 days of validation. finance will need a simple tiering matrix.

alaa (Legal): will draft addendum and a short de-id consent checkbox. aim to have templates ready in 3 business days.

dp-bot: New intake row added: "greenwell-health" (tags: hypothesis, regulated, interested in VPC).

rafa (PM): owners / next steps:
- jo: artifact template + interview scripts (Tue)
- moh: compatibility script + telemetry events (Wed)
- zara: conversion playbook outline + intake field for ARR (Wed)
- alaa: pilot addendum draft (Thu)
- rafa: hypothesis intake form + scoring rubric (Fri)

any objections to this flow? if not I'll spin up the intake and tag owners. :sparkles:

jo (Research): no objections, sounds tight.

moh (EngOps): good for me.

zara (Sales): thumbs up.

alaa (Legal): fine, will prioritize.

rafa (PM): thanks team  will post intake in #partners after templates are in place.
